title: Chocolate Day theme update for Question + Yes Celebration screens

requirements.summary: Make the Question screen Chocolate Day themed while preserving the two-option Yes/No choice and existing flow (Cover → Note → Question).
acceptanceCriteria: On the Question screen, the headline no longer says “Will you be my Valentine?” and is replaced with Chocolate Day themed copy.
Only two buttons are shown on the Question screen, labeled exactly “Yes” and “No” (case-sensitive).
The Cover and Note screens remain unchanged in flow and still precede the Question screen.

file_operations.description: Update the Question screen copy to be Chocolate Day themed (remove Valentine wording) and ensure the two action buttons are labeled exactly “Yes” and “No” (replace current “Yes! 💕” label). Keep the existing evasive No-button behavior, screen transitions, and continue to use the existing shadcn-ui Button component for the two options (verify the component's usage instructions before implementing).

requirements.summary: Replace the Yes-click Celebration screen with Chocolate Day themed message and the Chocolate Day illustration from frontend static assets.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking “Yes” transitions to a Celebration screen that includes the text “Happy Chocolate Day, my dear cutie 🍫💖” (exact characters).
The Celebration screen includes the additional sentence “All the best—focus well and give your best paper.” (exact punctuation/dash).

The Celebration screen displays the existing Chocolate Day illustration from the frontend static assets (no backend fetch) and no longer displays /assets/generated/valentine-good-choice-meme.dim_1024x1024.png.
The “No” button behavior and all other screen transitions still work as before.

file_operations.description: Update the Celebration screen content rendered after clicking “Yes” to: (1) show the exact message line “Happy Chocolate Day, my dear cutie 🍫💖”, (2) show the exact sentence “All the best—focus well and give your best paper.”, and (3) swap the image to the existing static asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/chocolate-day-scene.dim_1024x768.png (and remove usage of /assets/generated/valentine-good-choice-meme.dim_1024x1024.png). Keep all existing transitions and the Question screen No-button behavior unchanged; continue using existing UI primitives such as shadcn-ui Button where applicable (verify the component's usage instructions before implementing).
